errors.evidence: The dotted line does not show a downward trend from beginning to end; it actually shows an upward trend from the start to the end of the visible period.
The description mentions changes in index values but does not clearly state the main purpose of illustrating 'seasonally smoothed indices' as found in the figure's title.
The R-squared value and the polynomial equation on the chart are not mentioned in the description.
